acceptance: Every ambiguous worktree is removed or recorded as intentionally kept
git worktree list reports no prunable entries
description: `make worktree-reap APPLY=1` on 2026-10-22 removed 81 merged worktrees but left 42 it could not classify: 12 in detached HEAD, 11 with legacy lifecycle provenance (mostly under .muse/worktrees), 9 whose branch commits do not match the merged PR head, 3 with malformed provenance, 2 registered directories that no longer exist (temporary release-curation trees; `git worktree prune` on the host clears them) and the rest with unmerged PRs. It also kept 12 worktrees with uncommitted changes. Review each group and remove or keep it deliberately.
